recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11239; any ambiguity in MolecularDefinition coordinateInterval semantics should be handled as a new MolecularDefinition-specific Clinical Genomics issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11239 was a Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for the DSTU2 FHIR-core Sequence resource. It requested clearer coordinate-system wording for Sequence.referenceSeq.windowStart, specifically that the start position is inclusive for both 0-based and 1-based coordinate systems.
initial_application: Commit d830ddede2fa70d5f6ccca85e723caa4a2c7a7bf applied the coordinate-system clarification family, including FHIR-11239, to source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.sheet.txt and source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml. Historical release3 artifacts preserve Sequence.referenceSeq.windowStart with the applied inclusive-start rule.
additional_context: The current build no longer has an active Sequence or MolecularSequence source target: Sequence is a removed resource in source/fhir.ini, molecularsequence is commented out, and later R6 decisions replaced MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition. MolecularDefinition uses a different coordinateInterval representation model, so mechanically porting retired referenceSeq.windowStart prose would require a new model-specific decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty audit commit documenting that FHIR-11239 was already applied historically and is now outside current-build source scope.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive Sequence coordinateSystem issue applied by the same d830ddede2fa70d5f6ccca85e723caa4a2c7a7bf commit; it explains the coordinate-system framing but was not decided here.

Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 decision replacing MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition; it explains why the old Sequence/MolecularSequence paths are not current build targets.
Applied/Persuasive diagnostics-module clarification that MolecularSequence was replaced by MolecularDefinition; it supports the current-scope interpretation.
